title: Eye-Level Side Profile
prompt:
Eye-Level Side Profile
Hyper-realistic portrait photo, eye-level camera angle, three-quarter side profile of a beautiful young Asian woman with luminous "glass skin" — porcelain white tone, soft natural blush, defined natural lashes, slightly parted moist pink lips with subtle gloss. Shot from close distance, subject's face positioned on the left side of frame. Nose softly pouted, cheeks with gentle natural highlight. Long dark brown hair cascading over one shoulder, naturally thick and smooth with soft flyaways. Camera focus razor-sharp on the cheekbone and under-eye area, capturing fine skin texture, subtle pores, and dewy moisture. Lighting: warm side lighting casting a soft gradient shadow across the face. Evening/night ambience. Background: minimalist pale beige interior wall, softly blurred. Style resembles an iPhone portrait-mode selfie with faint wide-angle distortion at the edges. Aspect ratio 2:3.
